import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import time
import os

print(f"Total time remaining: 56 minutes")
start_time = time.time()

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/en_train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/en_test_2.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/en_sample_submission_2.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")
print(f"Train columns: {train.columns.tolist()}")
print(f"Test columns: {test.columns.tolist()}")

# Split training data into train/validation
train_val = train.sample(frac=0.95, random_state=42)
val = train.drop(train_val.index)

print(f"Validation set size: {len(val)}")


# Safe string conversion function that handles NaN values
def safe_convert_to_string(val):
    """Convert value to string, handling NaN values safely."""
    if isinstance(val, str):
        return val.strip()
    elif val is None or pd.isna(val):
        return ""
    else:
        return str(val).strip()


# Build lookup dictionaries from training data
print("Building lookup dictionaries...")
train_lookup = {}  # class-specific: (before, class) -> after
train_lookup_before = {}  # class-agnostic fallback: before -> after

for idx, row in train_val.iterrows():
    before_str = safe_convert_to_string(row["before"])
    class_str = safe_convert_to_string(row["class"])
    after_str = safe_convert_to_string(row["after"])

    # Class-specific lookup
    key = (before_str, class_str)
    if key not in train_lookup:
        train_lookup[key] = after_str

    # Class-agnostic fallback lookup (only store once, last value)
    if before_str not in train_lookup_before:
        train_lookup_before[before_str] = after_str

print(f"Class-specific lookup table size: {len(train_lookup)}")
print(f"Class-agnostic lookup table size: {len(train_lookup_before)}")

# Validate on hold-out (class-specific, since val has class column)
print("\nValidating on hold-out set...")
val_preds = []
for idx, row in val.iterrows():
    before_str = safe_convert_to_string(row["before"])
    class_str = safe_convert_to_string(row["class"])
    pred = train_lookup.get((before_str, class_str), before_str)
    val_preds.append(pred)

from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

val_accuracy = accuracy_score(val["after"].astype(str), val_preds)
print(f"Validation accuracy: {val_accuracy:.4f}")

# Make predictions on test set (class-agnostic fallback, since test lacks class column)
print("\nMaking predictions on test set...")
test_results = []

# Process test data in chunks for memory efficiency
chunk_size = 50000
n_chunks = (len(test) + chunk_size - 1) // chunk_size

for i in range(n_chunks):
    start_idx = i * chunk_size
    end_idx = min((i + 1) * chunk_size, len(test))

    chunk = test.iloc[start_idx:end_idx]

    for _, row in chunk.iterrows():
        before_str = safe_convert_to_string(row["before"])
        # Test set has no 'class' column, use class-agnostic fallback
        pred = train_lookup_before.get(before_str, before_str)
        row_id = f"{int(row['sentence_id'])}_{int(row['token_id'])}"
        test_results.append({"id": row_id, "after": pred})

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame(test_results)
submission = submission[["id", "after"]]

# Verify submission format
print(f"\nSubmission columns: {list(submission.columns)}")
print(f"Submission rows: {len(submission)}")
print(f"Expected rows: {len(test)}")

# Ensure submission directory exists
submission_dir = "./submission"
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Write submission
submission.to_csv(f"{submission_dir}/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to {submission_dir}/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Total time elapsed: {time.time() - start_time:.2f} seconds")
print("\nSample submissions:")
print(submission.head(5).to_string())

# Verify submission integrity
assert submission.shape[0] == len(test), "Submission row count mismatch"
assert list(submission.columns) == [
    "id",
    "after",
], f"Column mismatch: {list(submission.columns)}"
print("\n✓ Submission verification passed")
